answer: When k identities under common control equivocate on the same consensus evidence, the protocol aggregates attributable faults and applies a penalty proportional to k², so splitting stake cannot dilute liability. Detection also forfeits bonded escrow and triggers asymmetric depreciation, compounding capital loss by an exponential multiplier as correlated faults accumulate. An atlas of attestations can link identities operating across the haven and terrace domains, exposing a coordinated swarm rather than treating each address as independent.
